newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks soar in strong trade.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks soar in strong trade.

text.p: Caracas stocks roared ahead in strong trade in the last burst of the Christmas season, traders said.
"It was a good rally, especially for the end of the year," said Vencred broker Geronimo Paolini.

The market's leading index gained 1.67 percent to close at 6,349.47 points as 28 stocks rose, eight fell and 10 closed flat. Total trade was boosted to 58.8 million shares by large cross trades in paper company Manpa and Corimon B series shares.

Among widely-held stocks telephone company CANTV rose 6.00 bolivars to end at 1815.00, utility Electricidad de Caracas gained 8.40 bolivars to end at 541.00, and foods producer Mavesa closed up 5.25 bolivars at 154.25.
